_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd project_zomboid/egg-project-zomboid.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the project-zomboid tag, an automatic second UDP port (STEAM_PORT, no longer editable by customers), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), a broadcast command, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". Max players is an optional PLAYER_LIMIT written into the server ini before every start (the upstream MAX_PLAYERS was passed nowhere); the second port and auto-update have number rules; **install script fixed**: fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server.
name: Project Zomboid
author: iamkubi@gmail.com
description: Project Zomboid is an open world survival horror video game in alpha stage development by British and Canadian independent developer, The Indie Stone. The game is set in a post apocalyptic, zombie infested world where the player is challenged to survive for as long as possible before inevitably dying.
startup: PZ_INI="/home/container/.cache/Server/${SERVER_NAME}.ini"; if [ -n "${PLAYER_LIMIT}" ]; then if [ -f "${PZ_INI}" ]; then sed -i -E "s/^MaxPlayers=.*/MaxPlayers=${PLAYER_LIMIT}/" "${PZ_INI}"; else echo "Octail: Project Zomboid writes .cache/Server/${SERVER_NAME}.ini on this first start; Max Players applies from the next start."; fi; fi ; if [ "{{SERVER_MEMORY}}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && [ -f ProjectZomboid64.json ]; then sed -i -E "s/-Xmx[0-9]+[kKmMgG]/-Xmx$(( {{SERVER_MEMORY}} * 80 / 100 ))m/" ProjectZomboid64.json; fi ; export PATH="./jre64/bin:$PATH" ; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./linux64:./natives:.:./jre64/lib/amd64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" ; JSIG="libjsig.so" ; LD_PRELOAD="${LD_PRELOAD}:${JSIG}" ./ProjectZomboid64  -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -udpport {{STEAM_PORT}} -cachedir=/home/container/.cache -servername "{{SERVER_NAME}}" -adminusername {{ADMIN_USER}} -adminpassword "{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "The SteamCMD download failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/ProjectZomboid64 ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Project Zomboid dedicated server. Check the lines above, then reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
rm -f start-server.sh

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The internal server name used for save/ config files.

variables.name: SteamPort
variables.description: The second UDP port Project Zomboid needs. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Optional: the most players online at once, written to MaxPlayers in .cache/Server/<server name>.ini before every start (from the second start on: the game writes that file on the first). Empty = the ini's own value (32 by default).

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch [requires reinstall]
variables.description: Beta branch to install, such as b41multiplayer. Leave blank to install normal branch

variables.name: Steam Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off). Off by default: a game update can make mods and saves incompatible.
